gloss.en: The root صَفْصَف (ṣafṣaf) refers to a level, smooth, and barren land, devoid of vegetation, trees, or mountains. It implies a flat, empty expanse, often associated with a desert or a desolate plain.
gloss.short: The root صَفْصَف (ṣafṣaf) refers to a level, smooth, and barren land, devoid of vegetation, trees, or mountains.
